chromeExtension.metaTitle: Stripe Fee Auditor — CSV Fee Check Helper
chromeExtension.metaDescription: Install the free Chrome helper to open Stripe Balance export and audit your real fee rate. Optional monthly CSV reminder; no OAuth, API keys, or Stripe page access.
chromeExtension.heroTitle: Stripe Fee Auditor — CSV helper for your real fee rate
chromeExtension.heroDescription: Estimate published fees in the popup, jump to Stripe Balance export, and audit your CSV on FeeAuditor.com — no OAuth, no API keys, no reading Stripe Dashboard pages.
chromeExtension.feature1Body: Jump straight to Stripe's Balance export workflow instead of hunting through reports every month.
chromeExtension.feature2Body: Open Fee Auditor and upload the Balance CSV to check processing rate, all-in cost, and fee drivers.
chromeExtension.feature3Body: Use a local browser reminder to repeat the check before fee drift becomes invisible.
chromeExtension.privacy1: No Stripe OAuth and no API keys
chromeExtension.privacy3: Does not read Stripe Dashboard pages
chromeExtension.privacy4: Stores only the reminder setting in Chrome storage
chromeExtension.privacy5: CSV analysis still happens only when you choose to upload on feeauditor.com
chromeExtension.webAppBody: Upload a Balance CSV directly — same diagnosis, no extension required.
chromeExtension.usefulHeading: When the Chrome helper is useful
chromeExtension.usefulBody1: Use the helper when you already work in Stripe Dashboard and want a shorter path to the correct Balance export and Fee Auditor upload. It does not replace the web report or run a background Stripe integration; the CSV audit starts only when you choose a file.
chromeExtension.usefulBody2: If you prefer not to install an extension, use the web app directly. Both paths keep the same no-OAuth workflow and analyze the same effective rate, fee drivers, and costly rows.
chromeExtension.finalCtaTitle: Install the helper · audit on your terms
chromeExtension.finalCtaBody: Free extension. Fee analysis stays on feeauditor.com when you choose to upload.
chromeExtension.githubNote: Extension source is public on GitHub for review.
chromeExtension.cardSubtitle: CSV helper · no OAuth · no API keys
